description:
Assured is on a mission to modernize insurance. Claims processing (i.e. should we pay this claim?), while often overlooked, is the foundation of the entire industry. It’s currently highly manual, involving phone calls, faxes, and gut instinct, costing tens of billions of dollars a year. We can do better.

At Assured, we provide large insurers with the software solutions they need to win in a modern, technology-driven world. From self-service claim-filing software to backend fraud detection, we’re the engine that powers claims processing for some of the largest insurers in the world.

The challenges we face are deep and diverse, from creating digital experiences that provide comfort and clarity to claimants at their most stressed and vulnerable to orchestrating large-scale ML-driven decision-making on billions of dollars of claims payments, life at Assured is dynamic, collaborative, and rewarding.

We’re looking for a Staff or Principal Product Designer to help shape experiences across our AI, consumer, and enterprise products. Our work spans helping people report a claim and arrange repairs, giving adjusters better tools to understand and manage claims, and designing how people work with AI to move those claims forward.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role reporting to our Head of Product Design. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and other designers from early problem framing through launch and iteration, taking ownership of both the direction and quality of the experience.

We’re open to Staff and Principal candidates, with level and scope reflecting your experience and impact. We’ll shape your primary area of ownership around your strengths and our product needs, with opportunities to connect work across the broader product experience.


What you’ll do

  • Set the design direction and lead execution for a meaningful area of our product, connecting a longer-term vision with what we build next.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering early to frame problems, explore opportunities, and make thoughtful decisions about priorities and tradeoffs.

  • Build a deep understanding of the people using our products, from someone navigating an unfamiliar claim to a professional managing complex work every day.

  • Explore and test ideas through prototypes, user research, and customer feedback, then use what you learn to improve what we ship.

  • Bring clarity and polish to complex experiences through strong interaction design, information architecture, and visual design, staying closely involved through implementation.

  • Shape how AI fits into the experience, helping people understand what it’s doing, review its work, and take action when needed.

  • Work with other designers to connect experiences across products and develop shared patterns that can grow with us.

  • Raise the quality of the team’s work through thoughtful critique, mentorship, and a clear point of view.


What we’re looking for

  • Experience setting design direction and leading substantial product design work from early exploration through launch and iteration.

  • Strong craft across interaction and visual design, with a portfolio that shows how you make complex experiences clear, useful, and thoughtfully detailed.

  • Depth in consumer products, enterprise software, AI experiences, or similarly complex products, with an interest in working across these areas.

  • Systems thinking: the ability to connect individual interactions to broader workflows and develop patterns that hold together as a product grows.

  • Strong product judgment and close collaboration with Product and Engineering, balancing user needs, business goals, and technical constraints.

  • The ability to make progress through ambiguity, build alignment, and help other designers and partners do their best work.


Who will enjoy this role

You care about the larger product direction and the small details that make an experience feel right. You enjoy getting deep into an unfamiliar problem, forming a point of view, and working closely with others to bring it to life.

You’re excited by the range of work here, whether that means making a consumer experience feel effortless, simplifying a demanding professional workflow, or finding a useful new way for people to work with AI.

Insurance experience is not required. Curiosity, strong product judgment, and the ability to make unfamiliar, complex problems understandable matter much more.

Candidates are assessed against the three open areas described next. Interview details are included with each specific role.

Benefits:

🤑 Competitive Compensation: Competitive salary and equity packages for all employees

🏥 Healthcare Plan: Platinum medical, dental, and vision

🛡️ Free life insurance: Including long-term disability & short-term disability

🏄 Unlimited PTO: Uncapped vacation days & paid holidays

👶 Family Leave: Maternity & paternity

📈 401(k) Contribution: Assured contributes 3% of your income, even if you don't contribute

🏠 WFH Benefits: Lunch on us 2x/week, monthly phone stipend & other home office perks

👪 Health FSAs & HSAs: Pre-tax accounts for out-of-pocket medical expenses

🤝 Team events & Offsites: We're remote, but we regularly get together

**We have been made aware of individuals falsely posing as recruiters from Assured Insurance Technologies Inc. Please note that we only contact candidates from official @assured.claims email addresses and all interviews are conducted through verified company channels. If you are unsure whether a message is legitimate, please contact us directly at recruiting-ops@assured.claims before sharing any personal information**
